x: With Bill Belderson and Don Bartliff following Mason home Belgrave won the team race by 3 points. Farley was the winner of the Belgrave handicap prize, put up by the home club.
Bill Belderson took part in the British Police 2 mile track championship held at Smethwick Stadium, Birmingham on Saturday 20th July, finishing 6th in 16:43.
Charlie Capener was taking part in his first Open '7'. Bill Belderson was first M.P.A.A. member not gaining another award and Percy Wilson was 3rd in the Vets handicap.
Don Bartliff and Bill Belderson have both been posted elsewhere with the Police and we have seen little of them this year. Bob Barnes is now working in Cambridge and can only get down at weekends.
